nodes.rationale: Fractional subpixel bleed (100vw/18 columns = 21.666px) and per-tile stagger created visible hairlines on mobile. Fixed with column-grouped synchronized tweens and a 1px horizontal tile overlap (calc(100% + 1px), margin-left -0.5px).

nodes.label: Header Smooth IN Transition Desync Fix
nodes.rationale: Tailwind transition-all duration-300 fought GSAP at 60fps causing stutter; pill entered while green tiles still peeled (tileOut+=0.12 vs +0.48) and y:-45 pushed it out of the viewport. Fixed by removing transition-all, limiting CSS transitions to box-shadow and border-color, starting at y:-20 and moving entrance to tileOut+=0.40.
